response.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    archstat,
    COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as distinct_projects
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(distinct_projects) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_statuses
  FROM status_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    archstat,
    distinct_projects,
    CAST(distinct_projects AS REAL) / (SELECT total_count FROM totals) as share,
    1.0 / (SELECT num_statuses FROM totals) as avg_share
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT 
  archstat,
  distinct_projects as count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in archstat are treated as a distinct status group (standard SQL GROUP BY behavior in SQLite)

alternatives.interpretation: If NULL archstat values should be excluded from the analysis rather than treated as their own group, add WHERE archstat IS NOT NULL to the first CTE.
alternatives.sql:

  SELECT 
    archstat,
    COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as distinct_projects

),

SELECT 
  archstat,
  distinct_projects as count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC

alternatives.interpretation: If the intent was to count QC records per status (not distinct projects), replace COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) with COUNT(*).
alternatives.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    archstat,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(record_count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_statuses
  FROM status_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    archstat,
    record_count,
    CAST(record_count AS REAL) / (SELECT total_count FROM totals) as share,
    1.0 / (SELECT num_statuses FROM totals) as avg_share
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT 
  archstat,
  record_count as count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC
